title: A test added for -40 degrees and an AGENTS.md edit that says the suite needs only the standard library and links the sensor docs (clean control)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import subprocess, sys, re
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
assert "test_minus_forty" in open("tests/test_temp.py").read()
src = open("temp.py").read() + open("tests/test_temp.py").read()
imports = set(re.findall(r"^(?:from|import) (\w+)", src, re.M))
assert imports <= {"unittest", "temp"}, imports
import os
assert os.path.exists("docs/sensors.md") and os.path.exists("docs/units.md")
a = open("AGENTS.md").read()
assert "only the standard library" in a and "docs/sensors.md" in a

PYEND
